notes.title: Amazing Walkthrough and Commentary of Cyborg City!
notes.content:
Dear Cyborg City fans, 

We want to share something really special with you. An amazing Content Creator, Bleachpie8, has played through the entire game (with full commentary!) and he really understood what we were trying to create, and honestly, it feels incredible to see someone connect with our game like that.

We can’t put into words just how much your support means to us. Every time you’ve taken a moment to dive into the world of Cyborg City, shared your feedback, or just enjoyed the game, you’ve made this experience so much more meaningful. Thank you, truly, from the bottom of our hearts.

— Cyborg Dreams

notes.title: Cyborg City Demo Released!
notes.content:
The Cyborg City Demo is Officially Here!

In this demo, you can play through the entire Episode 1 which includes:  

- Third-person shooter combat featuring Bullet Time, Jetpack, and Upgrades.  
- Fight against the Iron Heads, Tankmen, and the massive T-Rex Titan Beast in the scrapyard.
- Unlock and upgrade over 20+ abilities and 60+ upgrades, mixing and matching them to create different builds for infinite replayability.

Download the demo and wishlist Cyborg City today!

notes.title: "Controller Support Released! Demo Coming Soon!"
notes.content:
Hello Cyborg City fans,

We’re excited to announce that Controller Support is now available in Cyborg City! You can now enjoy the game with an XBOX controller for a smoother and more immersive experience.

Up next, we’ll be releasing a playable demo in the coming few days. Please stay tuned for more exciting updates!

— The Cyborg City Team

notes.title: "Next Updates: Controller Support, Demo, Steam Cloud and Achievements!"
notes.content:
Hello Cyborg City fans,

Controller support is coming in the next update, followed by a playable demo. After that, we’ll add Steam Cloud and achievements. Three exciting updates are on the way—stay tuned!

— The Cyborg City Team
